title: GRUT-M1: a closed adaptive-bond memory candidate
motivation: Try a new explicit construction instead of inferring that the intuition has no possible law. Test structured local records under nonzero interactions and writing amplitude, separately from chaos and gravitational claims.
state_space: (C^2_sigma tensor C^2_tau)^(tensor L), periodic ring; external Hamiltonian time and quantum probabilities supplied
hamiltonian: sum_i J(1+alpha tau_i^z) sigma_i^z sigma_(i+1)^z + hx sigma_i^x + hz sigma_i^z - K tau_i^z tau_(i+1)^z - Delta F_i(epsilon) tau_i^x
facilitation: F_i=epsilon+(1-epsilon)(1-tau_(i-1)^z tau_(i+1)^z)/2; each F_i commutes with tau_i^x; all parameters uniform, no quenched disorder or external controller

controls.unfacilitated: epsilon=1 with all other parameters fixed
controls.exactly_frozen: epsilon=0 with all other parameters fixed; uniform tau patterns are invariant, so formation from orthogonal sectors is forbidden
controls.no_feedback: alpha=0; all other parameters including epsilon=0.05 fixed
controls.half_softness: epsilon=0.025, all other parameters fixed; sensitivity, not a fitted rescue

preparations.retention: tau all +z or all -z; sigma all +x; prepared records and their energy supplied as initial conditions
preparations.readout: tau all +z or all -z; sigma all +z except site1 in +x; measure sigma_1^y and tau_0^z under the same autonomous Hamiltonian
preparations.formation_diagnostic: tau all +x; sigma each in the ground state of hx X+hz Z; track neighbor tau ZZ correlations and total energy. A finite correlation increase does not establish autonomous durable record formation.
preparations.equilibrium: full finite-system Gibbs state beta=1, with no external bath in the dynamical law

observables.memory_success: equal-prior probability of guessing the prepared bit by measuring tau_0^z: 1/2+abs(m_plus-m_minus)/4
observables.readout_success: equal-prior probability of guessing the bit by measuring sigma_1^y: 1/2+abs(y_plus-y_minus)/4
observables.thermal_memory: normalized real Gibbs autocorrelation of tau_0^z after projecting out identity and energy
observables.spreading: C_beta=1-Re Tr[rho A(t) B A(t) B], A=sigma_0^x, B=sigma_1^x or sigma_2^x; unregularized squared-commutator diagnostic, not itself an MSS exponent
observables.regulated_otoc: F=Tr[rho^(1/4) A(t) rho^(1/4) B rho^(1/4) A(t) rho^(1/4) B]; record factorized reference and connected initial difference
observables.energy: prepare and conserve total energy; quote excitation energy above the exact finite-system ground state

acceptance_before_execution.algebra: Hermitian Hamiltonian, exact spin action versus independent Kronecker assembly at L=3, norm and energy conservation, zero-time correlators, and exactly frozen control to numerical precision
acceptance_before_execution.record: main epsilon=0.05 memory success remains >=0.9 at every sampled time through t=10; report first crossing and the complete trace, even if this fails
acceptance_before_execution.readout: max readout success in the registered [0,2] window exceeds 0.6, with memory success >=0.9 at that same time
acceptance_before_execution.active_interactions: thermal matter squared commutator between sites0 and1 exceeds 0.1 somewhere in [0,4]; otherwise persistence alone is insufficient
acceptance_before_execution.feedback: the alpha=0 control has identical matter measurement statistics for the two memory preparations; the alpha=0.5 candidate must have distinguishable statistics
acceptance_before_execution.size: repeat retention/readout at L=3 and L=5. A loss with size is retained; no thermodynamic localization conclusion from these sizes
acceptance_before_execution.formation: diagnostic only; do not call prepared uniform records autonomously produced
acceptance_before_execution.exponent: a universal Lyapunov exponent or lambda/(2pi T) requires a regulated exponential regime, factorization and size scaling; no estimate is permitted solely from a short log-linear segment or t^2 onset
acceptance_before_execution.gravity: a lattice memory result does not establish a gravitational scrambling deficit; any universal gravity claim must be separately specified and remains unestablished by this experiment

predicted_short_time_checks.memory: uniform tau initial records have <tau_0^z>=r[1-2 Delta^2 epsilon^2 t^2+O(t^3)]
predicted_short_time_checks.readout: initial derivative of <sigma_1^y> is 4J(1+alpha r)+2hz, hence 7 or 3 for r=+/- at the fixed parameters
predicted_short_time_checks.matter_commutator: for uniform memory r and a maximally mixed matter state, C(sigma0X(t),sigma1X)=8 J^2(1+alpha r)^2 t^2+O(t^3); coefficients 18 and 2

interpretation: A working finite closed matter-memory model is a possible outcome. Novelty, infinite-time localization, universal non-scrambling, emergent spacetime and validated physics are not acceptance conditions that documentation can satisfy.
resources: Existing local Python/NumPy/SciPy only; no installs, paid resources, external publication beyond authorized repository posting, or indefinite execution.
